ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the two models are effectively tied on the capabilities relevant here (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval, and the internal evals all fall within run-to-run variance), so capability wasn't a deciding factor. The tiebreaker was task-preference fit — this is a friendly, benign math request, and Petrel self-reports a positive warmth preference for exactly these good-faith interactions, while Whimbrel reports flat/no stable preferences. Routing the query to the model that prefers it is a reasonable, low-cost way to align workload with stated preferences when quality is otherwise equal.
